name: dynamic-text
title: Dynamic Text
description: Word-to-word morph where letters are physical: shared letters glide to their new spot on a spring arc, others fall away, new ones drop in and land with a squash.
useWhen: A headline word should change into another while keeping the letters they share, so the change reads as one object transforming.
A counter or a short list of words (Create, Iterate, Repeat, Ship) needs a physical, tactile swap.
avoidWhen: The two words share almost no letters and a plain swap is enough: use slide-swap or per-word-crossfade.
A whole sentence changes: use kinetic-morph-text.
author: Kokonut UI

variables.label: Words
variables.description: Words separated by |. The text morphs from each one to the next. Digits roll like a counter.

variables.label: Interval
variables.description: Seconds each word holds before the morph to the next.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Maximum text size in pixels. Wide words shrink to fit the frame.
